kindPolicyNote: Per strategy.kind: on (default when absent), experimental (signals are reported but not emitted as wires) or off. Derived from experiment emotion-detection-v1 (its evaluator was deleted with the neural strategies; the results stay in the history reports): on at precision >= 0.85 over >= 3 predictions, experimental at >= 0.6, off below. symbolic.irony_possible stays on as a soft signal (score capped at 0.5). The neural and LLM strategies were removed on 2026-10-01 (hygiene H19); their recorded results stay in the history reports.
